SRC-004:R0001.text: Project-tab navigation must never call _push_sync_files with slots=None; publish only dirty outgoing owners and keep full reconcile for explicit durability or repair paths.

SRC-004:R0002.text: Huge documents at or above the configured character or block threshold must not receive a full rich Markdown rehighlight during navigation.

SRC-004:R0003.text: Project switching must preserve a bounded category-aware document cache so warm A-B-A switching does not rebuild unchanged QTextDocuments.

SRC-004:R0004.text: Warm document switches must use generation identity and must not materialize doc.toPlainText solely for whole-text equality comparison.

SRC-004:R0005.text: A project-tab switch must refresh the visible silo list once, with line counts cached by content generation rather than rescanned from sibling text.

SRC-004:R0006.text: update_preview must return before reading editor text outside Reading mode and must accept the already-available incoming text snapshot for Reading mode.

SRC-004:R0007.text: Document attach must not synchronously scan every block for checkbox and code metadata on huge unchanged documents; metadata must be cached or deferred incrementally.
